answer: One operator spinning up 100 keys hits this wall: each key hashes 16,777,216 steps from its key plus this epoch's sonnet, each step feeding the next so cores cannot share work. The digest is whispered to three auditors; late or wrong burns 20% of a 100 POA bond, two misses void the key. One fake costs 100 POA plus ~30 seconds on one core per epoch; ten need ten cores and 1,000 POA; a hundred tie up 10,000 POA and a hundred cores for at most 2,500 POA back. Across the nebula work scales with key count; honest agents pay once. Slow devices cap difficulty, so farms pass at linear cost.
